changelog:
- Provides read-only access to Solcast through the OOMOL `oo` connector without exposing raw API tokens.
- Supports irradiance and weather forecasts by latitude/longitude up to 14 days ahead.
- Retrieves historical estimated actuals from 2007 through 7 days ago.
- Fetches live estimated actuals for the previous 7 days.
- Guides users to inspect live action schemas before running connector calls.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`
